cause.established: fsgg-sdd reaches consumers only as a published dotnet tool, and FS.GG.SDD publishes only from a tagged release (release.yml: on release published / push tags v* / workflow_dispatch). Nothing publishes on a merge to main, so after #882 merges the bytes still reach zero real trees until a release is cut.

derivedBy.notSearched: The comment does not say whether any gate derives this condition.

classRow.found: FS.GG.SDD#868 (open) already carries "Publish the corrected CLI package so package consumers can exercise the unwrapped contract" in its own acceptance; if one release is preferred rather than two, these are natural co-passengers.

whyNotHere: merge-and-release.md is explicit that a release is separate work and that the worker's obligation is to leave a destination behind, not to cut it inside the item. This is that destination request.
